format: C++/Python hybrid (cpp with embedded Python C API)
description: Source code for the Python engine implementation in PyTorch's autograd system, including engine management, thread handling, backward execution, and Python-C++ interface setup.

classes.name: THPEngine
classes.description: Python interface for the autograd engine, managing backward execution and thread handling.

methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the PythonEngine, reinitializing if needed.

methods.description: Handles exceptions in engine threads, persisting Python errors.

methods.description: Returns default hooks for saved variables.
